profile_text.body:
Google is a public company founded in 1998 and headquartered in Mountain View, California, traded on public markets under the ticker GOOGL. Its website, centered on the Gemini product, describes Gemini as Google's AI assistant, offering help with writing, planning, and brainstorming through generative AI. The company reported revenue of $402,836,000,000 for the period ending December 31, 2025, filed as a 10-K.

Google's tracked AI products span several categories. Gemini is its general large language model assistant, with Google AI Studio serving developers for model prototyping. NotebookLM provides document-grounded research assistance by ingesting user-uploaded corpora. Google Med-PaLM and MedLM are medical large language models aimed at clinical reasoning and healthcare data use, with a HIPAA Business Associate Agreement required. Workspace-integrated products include Google Drive AI and Google Meet AI, which add summarization, live captions, and note-taking within Google's productivity suite. TensorFlow and Keras, Google's open-source machine learning frameworks, round out the portfolio alongside the TensorFlow Extended MLOps tooling.

The site's held facts note 175 legal matters associated with California, though no individual case details are recorded. Google holds a CIK of 0001652044 with the SEC. A range of third-party Model Context Protocol servers built around Google services, including multiple Google Ads management tools, Google News, Google Search Console, Google Forms, Google Calendar, and Google Trends integrations, appear in the MCP registry linked to Google's platforms.
